findings.detail: Option B of M4-S60-T1 says the Explore subagent prevents context exhaustion by returning only a short summary of its findings. That is the answer of M4-S55-T3, whose correct option says the subagent returned raw output instead of a summary.

The stem of M4-S48-T2 and its option A describe the -p flag as running Claude Code in non-interactive mode in a pipeline. This gives away the correct option D of M4-S57-T1, which adds -p so the job runs unattended.

Option D of M4-S53-T1 states that the allowed-tools frontmatter of a skill restricts which tools (Edit and Write) it may use. This reveals the mechanism that is the correct answer of M4-S52-T1 (add allowed-tools to the SKILL.md frontmatter).

Option A of M4-S57-T1 says the --json-schema flag makes the job receive structured output. This points directly to the correct option B of M4-S49-T1 (--output-format json with --json-schema for machine-parseable findings).
Correct option C of M4-S46-T3 states that files are loaded when they are imported with @import. This hints at the correct option A of M4-S47-T2, which references a shared standards file with @import.
